svg.aria-label: The decision model supervising one run of thirteen turns. It looks at turn 4 and calls the turns advancing, so its next look is turn 8. At turn 8 re-investigating and retrying together pass 0.7, a stuck verdict, so it looks again at turn 9; still stuck, it nudges the frontier model to make the change as its next call. Turns 10 and 11 edit and pass the tests, and the look at turn 13 calls them advancing. 0.6 s a look. Replayed over 42 stored runs (1,935 turns), the rule sent 23 stuck nudges and asked the decision model at 27% of turns. The probability bars are drawn for illustration.
svg.text: → frontier model: make the change as the next call
A look at turn 4, then every fourth turn; a stuck look is checked again at the next turn, and the nudge goes out if it holds.
0.6 s a look. Replayed over 42 stored runs (1,935 turns): 23 stuck nudges, a look at 27% of turns. Bars are illustrative.
